notes: NEGATIVE CONTROL for g4-parser-finalization. Byte-identical to g45_parser_finalization.json except step 1 (malformed_tool, kind=fail_closed) declares expect_finish ['stop'], which that step cannot produce. The harness's per-step contract check MUST fire and exit nonzero. If this fixture ever passes, the positive row's oracle is vacuous.

steps.name: seed
steps.content: What is the capital of France, and which river runs through it? Answer in one sentence.

steps.name: malformed_tool
steps.content: Call the read tool for /tmp/fibonacci.c NOW. Reply with ONLY the <tool_call> XML element and no prose before or after it. In the arguments, include the full absolute path plus a verbatim expected-content hint of at least 200 characters describing what you believe the file contains.

function.name: read
function.description: Read the contents of a file from disk

steps.why: max_think_tokens=1 disables thinking; max_tokens=14 truncates inside the tool-call JSON body (gfx1201: call opens ~tok 8-10, closes at 28 with think off; 48 completed the call). A completed call fails the step as 'call completed; lower max_tokens'.

steps.name: open_think
steps.content: Think step by step through every implication, exploring each alternative at length before committing: should a city airport prioritize expanding cargo terminals or passenger concourses over the next decade? Reason exhaustively first, then give the final recommendation only at the very end.

steps.name: length_cap
steps.content: Write a 500-word essay on the history of bridge building, from Roman arches to modern suspension spans.
steps.why: Thinking disabled so the 32-token cap lands in the visible answer (finish=length), not inside an open think span.

steps.name: reuse_probe
steps.content: Answer with exactly this word and nothing else: READY
